# dsh-compressor

> In-process DeepSeek Harness plugin. Compresses long tool results with official Headroom Rust crushers, stores originals on disk, restores them with compressor_retrieve.

This fork (`lifeodyssey/dsh-compressor`) is not the Headroom proxy/MCP product. Install the plugin; do not `headroom wrap` or `headroom proxy` from this repo.

## Canonical

- [GitHub](https://github.com/lifeodyssey/dsh-compressor): source, issues, PR #18
- [Plugin readme](https://github.com/lifeodyssey/dsh-compressor/blob/feat/deepseek-harness-plugin/plugins/dsh-compressor/README.md): install and publish
- Issues live on `lifeodyssey/dsh-compressor` only. Always `gh … -R lifeodyssey/dsh-compressor`.

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add ./plugins/dsh-compressor
# or, after publish:
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-compressor
# or from GitHub:
dsh plugin --profile web add github:lifeodyssey/dsh-compressor#path:plugins/dsh-compressor
```

## Protocol

- Locator: `<<compressor:64-hex-sha256>>`
- Tool: `compressor_retrieve` (`locator` = full locator or bare hash)
- Store: `$DSH_HOME/dsh-compressor/<hash>`
- Hooks: `agent/pre-step`, `tools/post-execute`
- Skip: user/system/assistant, Read/Glob/Grep/Write/Edit/Web*, short text, protected errors, recent source_code, official DSH spill notices
